strapiBlog.title: Dubai Land Department Embraces AI to Improve Accuracy in Property Listings
strapiBlog.short_description: The Dubai Land Department (DLD) has introduced an AI-powered Real Estate Advertising Governance Platform to enhance the accuracy and transparency of property listings.

data.text:
The Dubai Land Department (DLD) has introduced an AI-powered Real Estate Advertising Governance Platform to enhance the accuracy and transparency of property listings. This platform monitors advertisements across major portals. Since its launch, over 279,000 listings have been reviewed, with 29% automatically modified to align with regulatory standards.

This initiative is part of DLD's broader strategy to integrate AI in real estate, ensuring that property advertisements are accurate, compliant, and trustworthy. By leveraging AI solutions for real estate listings, DLD aims to foster a more transparent and reliable property market in Dubai.

Enhancing Transparency with 'Madmoun'

Complementing the AI platform, DLD has implemented the 'Madmoun' electronic service within the Trakheesi system. This service generates a unique QR code for each real estate advertisement permit. Real estate companies are required to display these QR codes on all advertisements, enabling consumers to verify the authenticity of listings instantly.

This measure further strengthens the integrity of AI property listings, providing an additional layer of verification and boosting consumer confidence in the real estate sector.

Strategic Partnerships and Future Outlook

DLD's commitment to innovation extends beyond AI implementation. The department has partnered with REACH, a global real estate technology accelerator, to drive further advancements in the sector. This collaboration aims to attract emerging proptech companies to Dubai, fostering an ecosystem of innovation and excellence in real estate services.

These strategic initiatives align with Dubai's vision to position itself as a global leader in real estate innovation, leveraging AI real estate listings and other technological advancements to enhance the market's efficiency and transparency.
